name: Risa International Limited
about: Risa International Limited engages in the trading of textiles in India. It operates through two segments: Trading and Real Estate. The company is also involved in trading iron and steel, and third-party product distribution. In addition, it engages in the realty business. The company was formerly known as Govindji Trikamdas Exports Ltd. Risa International Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.
